market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $130 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI peaked at ~$110 in May, currently ~$93-100. Reaching $130 by end-June requires a ~30% rebound and a major supply disruption beyond what was seen even at the Hormuz peak. Analyst targets cap at ~$115 Brent. $130 WTI requires a true black-swan supply shock.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Possibility of full Hormuz closure or wider Middle East conflict
